_provenance: Systemic (barycentric) radial velocities for stars carrying a threshold crossing that the released catalogue's own radial-velocity table (starrv_v399.json) does not hold, because they entered the crossing list with the archival tail rather than with the release.  Queried from SIMBAD on 2026-10-04 and frozen here with the bibcode SIMBAD returns, so the mask's frame chain carries no number without a source.  Used only to transform a crossing frequency into its star's rest frame; nothing in the search depends on it.

HD 139084 B.note: M5Ve companion of HD 139084 (V343 Nor, beta Pic moving group); the primary's SIMBAD value is +3.90 +- 0.19 km/s from Gaia DR3, consistent with it, and either leaves this crossing attributed.
